mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 3.0% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth slows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 20-day SPX returns over a 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern is not observed when both series decline by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC of UNRATE with 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, as measured by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), indicates robust economic activity and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of PAYEMS with 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day returns when PAYEMS increases are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate output and profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 110.0 in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC of INDPRO with 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth expectations fall, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * GDPC1) has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 60-day SPX returns over a 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern is not observed when both series decline by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually) with the federal funds rate not sufficiently accommodative (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%), the central bank's delayed response to inflation causes equity market sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with inadequate monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or the combined signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 20-day returns over a 3-year rolling window.
